name: 2-oleoylglycerol
description: 2-Oleoylglycerol (CAS 3443-84-3 ) is a monoglyceride formed from glycerol and oleic acid, functioning as an emulsifier, carrier, and humectant across pharmaceutical, food, and cosmetic applications. It is structurally distinct from the more common 1-oleoylglycerol isomer, making it relevant in research-grade and specialty formulation contexts where positional specificity matters for the final product. In pharmaceutical formulation, it acts as a lipid-based carrier in drug delivery systems, improving solubilization and absorption of poorly water-soluble active ingredients during the manufacturing process. Food manufacturers use it as an emulsifier to stabilize fat-in-water systems in processed foods, spreads, and bakery products. It provides consistent texture and shelf stability in various food matrices. In personal care, it functions as a skin-conditioning emollient and co-emulsifier in creams and lotions, supporting moisture retention. This makes it a versatile ingredient for high-end cosmetic formulations. It also serves as a biochemical reference standard and research reagent in lipid metabolism studies, where isomeric purity is a critical procurement specification for laboratory and clinical researchers. 2-Oleoylglycerol is typically supplied as a liquid or low-melting solid, depending on purity and temperature conditions. It is available in research-grade and high-purity grades suited to analytical applications. Packaging ranges from small quantities for laboratory use to larger volumes for industrial formulation.
